title: Choose the Ordering
prompt: Implement three functions over one `std::atomic<unsigned>`: `bumpRelaxed` (statistics: relaxed is enough), `publishAndSpin` (release store, acquire load on a bool+int pair), and `seqTotal` (fetch_add with seq_cst, return the previous value).

tests.name: relaxed bump accumulates
publish/consume round-trips
tests.hint: publishAndSpin: value = v; flag.store(true, std::memory_order_release);  consumeAfter: while (!flag.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {} return value;

tests.name: seq_cst returns the previous
tests.hint: return counter.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_seq_cst); — fetch_add returns the OLD value.
